run_convert_masks_tool: run the ConvertMasksTool CLI to convert Detectron2 segmentation masks to binary mask images
create_mask_from_segmentation: create binary masks from Detectron2 instance segmentation files using the ConvertMasksTool
infer_masks_from_previous: infer current frame mask from previous frame using bounding box IOU overlap
draw_mask_polygon: draw a polygon mask on the current image using mouse drawing in the tool
combine_segmentation_masks: combine multiple segmentation masks using the combine mode feature in the tool
